Returns values of attributes for the specified streams over the specified time range suitable for plotting over the number of intervals (typically represents pixels).
get.description: For each interval, the data available is examined and significant values are returned. Each interval can produce up to 5 values if they are unique, the first value in the interval, the last value, the highest value, the lowest value and at most one exceptional point (bad status or digital state). Any time series value in the response that contains an 'Errors' property indicates PI Web API encountered a handled error during the transfer of the response stream.
